title: Register Conventions of the Member Services Desk: Acceptance, Elections and Recorded Particulars on a Membership and Patronage Equity Account
content:
The board accepts or declines a membership application under Membership and Patronage Equity at its next sitting, and until it has accepted one the account earns nothing and votes nothing. On acceptance the class's common stock is issued and voting rights are granted where the class carries them.

**The tax election.** The election between qualified and nonqualified treatment is the member's to make and is recorded on their signed election. It takes effect prospectively only: for allocations posted after the election, and not for years already posted.

**A recorded death.** A recorded death is entered only from the certified documentation the class requires, never from what a caller says, and entering it moves the membership onto the estate class at the next allocation.

**The year of birth.** The year of birth is corrected only against the identity document on the membership application, because it decides age retirement.

**Inactivity.** A membership with no qualifying business for the class's inactivity period in whole fiscal years is treated as inactive, which stops the annual meeting notice but does not touch the equity or its place in the revolvement cycle.

**The standing a membership must be in to be changed.** A membership is updated only while it stands in active, allocation hold or revolving, since a retired or transferred account is closed to change. The standing is read from the cooperative's own record of the membership before the change is made, and the membership is identified by its membership number so that the standing read is that of the account being changed.

## Points of judgement

| The membership stands in | May its particulars be changed |
| --- | --- |
| active | yes |
| allocation hold | yes |
| revolving | yes |
| retired | no; the account is closed to change |
| transferred | no; the account is closed to change |
| applied | the board has not yet accepted it, and until it does the account earns nothing and votes nothing |

**On the election.** A member who signs a change of tax election after the year's allocation has been posted has it take effect for allocations posted after the election; the year already posted is unaffected.

**On a caller's word.** A caller reporting a member's death does not cause a death to be recorded; only the certified documentation the class requires does that.
